description: Classic content for DRAGSTER and ZOOM ZOO (the v9 entries, unchanged) and, from TRACK-BREADTH part 3, the fourteen other race tracks a cold start reaches: per track its decoded data, tile columns, tile flags and BG1 tiles (track.NN.*, R-0046 observations 1-2), per scenery (track mod 14) its BG2 tiles, BG2 map and race palette (scenery.SS.*, `$82:DC20-DD84`), and the track name table (`$83:9FFA`). Every new entry is ROM content located by the loader's own directories; tools/unirally_lab/content/tracks.py v10_new_entries generates them. From SPECIAL-TILE-RESPONSE (v11): the two 48-byte signed height tables the corkscrew tile steps through ($00:8088 and, for a rolling rider, $00:80B8; R-0047). From LOCKED-TOURS (v12): the twenty race tracks of the five tours a cold start does not list (track.NN.* for 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 16, 18, 19, 25, 26, 28, 29, 35, 36, 38, 39, 40, 41, 43, 44) and sceneries 1, 8 and 12 (tracks.v12_new_entries). From TILE-PAIRS-8-12-26 (v13): the loop tile's 17 signed x steps by loop step ($81:834C; R-0051).
